name: Claude Certified Architect - Foundations
description: Validates the ability to make sound architectural decisions for production Claude systems: agentic orchestration and multi-agent coordination, Claude Code configuration and CI/CD workflows, prompt engineering and guaranteed structured output, tool and MCP server design, and context management/reliability at scale. Scenario-anchored: every exam question references one of six production-design scenarios.

domains.name: Agentic Architecture & Orchestration
domains.description: The agentic loop and stop_reason handling, orchestration pattern selection (prompt chaining, routing, orchestrator-workers, dynamic decomposition, parallel subagents), coordinator/subagent responsibility splits, tool distribution, hooks and prerequisite gates as enforcement, state persistence, and provenance for multi-agent research/extraction systems.

domains.name: Claude Code Configuration & Workflows
domains.description: CLAUDE.md hierarchy and scoping, skills and slash commands, plan mode vs. direct execution, permissions.deny and hooks as enforcement, built-in tool selection, session management and resumption, and CI/CD integration via non-interactive mode.

domains.name: Prompt Engineering & Structured Output
domains.description: System prompt design and XML structure, few-shot examples, prompt dilution over long conversations, structured/guaranteed output mechanisms (JSON Schema, strict tool use, tool_choice), schema vs. semantic validation, fabrication reduction in extraction, validation feedback loops, and the Batch API's latency tradeoff.

domains.name: Tool Design & MCP Integration
domains.description: Tool description design and routing reliability, parameter and output design patterns, composite-tool rules, error classification and structured tool-error results, MCP error tiers, MCP's tools/resources/prompts building blocks, MCP configuration scoping and precedence, and progressive tool availability.

domains.name: Context Management & Reliability
domains.description: The stateless-core principle, context-shrinking strategies, the lost-in-the-middle effect, escalation patterns and structured handoffs, error propagation between agents, confidence calibration, information provenance, graceful degradation, and code-level compliance enforcement.
